answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 59985 Country: India Title: Urinary incontinence Question: I am suffering from urine incontinence. I know I have to make wudhu for every prayer, but washing private part and clothes for every prayer is very much difficult for me. Please guide me to an easy way as there is no difficulty in Islam, guide me according to Hadith and Quran. Answer ID: 59985 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 772/762/N=09/1436) If you are suffering from the urine drops after urination then you should put any thick cloth under your underwear after urinating which could absorb the drops of the urine. And when it is stopped then you should remove it and wash the part. And in other times if you observe drops then you should put this cloth permanently and remove it and wash the part before offering the salah. And then you can perform wudhu and offer salah. And in case you experience it very often then write the complete situation of your problem and submit the query again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
